quality_gates.guide: Exact 126-word locked copy; immutable guide and receipt; WAV probe; prior pinned tail-energy completeness threshold of 0.02 plus human ending listen; stop on any failure or uncertainty.
quality_gates.transfer: Only from a passed guide; Original C identity and full exact copy; immutable receipt and WAV; no word loss, reordered branch, clipped ending or audible artifacts.
quality_gates.word_timing_and_captions: Align every locked word to the final Original C master. Captions are verbatim and word-timed; scene-local summary text does not substitute for captions.

quality_gates.program_audio: One continuous Original C master under host and explanatory screens; generated presenter clip audio muted. The two-second end card has no new spoken CTA.
quality_gates.review: Technical checks, sound-on phone playback and owner acceptance are separate gates. A successful provider response or silent HyperFrames pass is not owner video approval.

broker_branch_claim_limits.single_question: Ask what happens to a business a broker cannot list because it is not ready.
broker_branch_claim_limits.branch_one: IF the broker already does that work free, the referral channel MAY be blocked; do not depict this as an observed or universal outcome.
broker_branch_claim_limits.branch_two: IF the broker turns it away or refers it elsewhere, ask what was missing and who handles it now; do not turn a hypothetical answer into a lead or paying client.
broker_branch_claim_limits.bounded_payoff: The conversation can surface readiness problems and possible owner access; it does not establish volume, conversion, sale outcomes or market demand.
broker_branch_claim_limits.demand_boundary: A referral proves access, not demand. An owner agreeing to pay begins to prove this business, but one payment would not validate the whole market.
